column2: A tiny original baby snail character seen from the side, facing screen right. Soft chubby rounded slug body in warm cream yellow, one big round spiral shell on its back in teal green with one simple darker spiral line. Head is one third of total height, round face at the right end of the body, two short stubby eye stalks with big black bead eyes, small pink cheeks, a small clearly drawn closed mouth line. No arms, no legs, no clothes.

A small original chubby tree frog character, facing screen left. Pear shaped body in bright leaf green with a pale yellow belly, head is half of total height, two big round eyes on top of the head with black bead pupils, a wide simple closed mouth line, short stubby arms and legs, a small orange neck scarf. Stands upright on two feet.
